comment: Dr. Wu is a great guy, but as everyone says, he's not the best teacher. The truth is that if you took AP Bio and have a solid understanding of biology and usually test well, you will do fine. This course was a lot of work - there were weeks where he assigned tests and 4 other assignments. He's the type of professor to give you a 23.6/24.

Like everyone says he is a great guy but only an OKAY professor. I made it through this class because I took AP Bio. The pre-lab lectures are so painful. I would stay away if possible but if you end up with him it's not the end of the world. I will say though, he is very accessible outside of class and wants you to do well if you make an effort.

He is a nice person but teaching is clearly not his strong suit. Lectures were boring. The content is pretty much the same as AP Bio and was less comprehensive than the AP class. He took off points for things on tests that were not clearly needed in the answer. He graded presentations extremely harshly. Lab intros longer than necessary.

Dr. Wu is very caring and smart, but that does NOT make him a good teacher. His lectures can be interesting, but literally nothing on the tests is related to them. You could memorize word for word everything on the slides and in lecture and it does not matter, the test will be some random situation he picked out of nowhere. AVOID HIM IF YOU CAN

Dr. Wu is very kind and caring. One thing I didn't like was how the assignments were all related to lab and not lecture, which made it difficult to keep up with the lecture material as exams approached. He is not consistent with giving practice exams/problems, so it is difficult to study for the exams. Overall, very approachable and willing to help

Dr. Wu is a solid choice for bio 200. Class is lecture-based, and can get boring at times. Exams are not overly difficult, however he grades randomly at times. He does appointments for office hours and is very responsive if you reach out for help. Btw he is lactose if you didn't know.

Dr. Wu is the best thing to happen to the Biology department. I took him for BIO 200 (a notoriously difficult course) but loved every second of it. I wasn't the best student at first, but his door was always open during office hours and helped me understand where I was making mistakes. Such a great professor, if you see his name just take him!

Bio 200 is a challenging course in general but Dr. Wu tries to make it bearable and is willing to answer any questions if you reach out to him. Most of the content on his tests comes from his lectures so you have to pay attention during class. His class was difficult at times but that will be the case for most bio 200 professors.

He is a good person that means well but he was just not meant to teach Bio200. The lectures are very unorganized, we can do as little as one minute on one slide to half the class. Tests are difficult to prepare for, often what is emphasized in class is not on the exam. Bio200 is a difficult class in general but the class structure does not help.

Grading criteria is extremely unclear. Lectures are often irrelevant tangents that dont matter for the tests. The tests are overly difficult/ confusing and for many students scores are miscalculated. One positive thing is that he is kind of funny. This was genuinely the worse class I have ever taken at UR.

Dr. Wu is a really nice guy who knows a great deal about Biology, but is awful at teaching. All classes are lectures. Grading criteria is extremely unclear. Little to no preparation for tests. Also, he grades very harshly. The average test grade is usually a B-. Very unhelpful feedback and little to no guidance for projects. You've been warned...
Dr. Wu is the sweetest person ever! He is really passionate about the BIOL 200 topic, which makes the topic more interesting. 10/10 recommend. Amazing!
Loved taking Molecular Virology with Dr. Wu! He shapes the course and lab to allow for student choice. Definitely not too difficult to do well in his class!

Dr. Eugene is a nice professor and the "Invasions in Biology" section of BIOL 199 is amazing! Dr. Eugene is brilliant, but he seems to dumb down a lot of the material to the point where it becomes boring in lecture. He's very helpful if you ask and emails back quickly. He and his wife, Dr. Carrie team-taught the class, and it was a great time!

Cool guy, I had him for lab. Lab was actually pretty fun. Dr. Wu maintains a relaxed atmosphere and is helpful when we inevitably ran into problems. Grading is fair. Genetics lab has a bad reputation at UR, but I had a good time and learned a lot in Dr. Wu's lab. Just never ask him about his lactose intolerance, you'll never hear the end of it.
